target_moa.text: DaxibotulinumtoxinA-lanm is an acetylcholine release inhibitor and neuromuscular blocking agent that blocks cholinergic transmission at the neuromuscular junction by cleaving SNAP25, inhibiting release of acetylcholine.

detail.text: Distant spread of toxin effect: the effects of DAXXIFY and all botulinum toxin products may spread from the area of injection to produce symptoms consistent with botulinum toxin effects; swallowing and breathing difficulties can be life threatening and there have been reports of death.

citations.quote: The effects of DAXXIFY and all botulinum toxin products may spread from the area of injection to produce symptoms consistent with botulinum toxin effects. These symptoms have been reported hours to weeks after injection. Swallowing and breathing difficulties can be life threatening and there have been reports of death. DAXXIFY is not approved for the treatment of spasticity or any conditions other than glabellar lines. (5.1)
